narr: Abundant tropical moisture was over the Coastal Bend on September 3rd. Scattered thunderstorms with very heavy rainfall produced flash flooding in Corpus Christi.
ev: High water was reported on several roads near the downtown area. Barricades were requested to close off affected roads.
Multiple streets in the South Shore Estates of Corpus Christi were flooded.
